crossRefs.note: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
“Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
to him who by understanding made the heavens; for his loving kindness endures forever:
Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.

translations.web: God who is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who has hardened himself against him and prospered?
translations.bsb: God is wise in heart and mighty in strength. Who has resisted Him and prospered?
translations.kjv: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?
translations.asv: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: Who hath hardened himself against him, and prospered?-
